row.notes: Writes the address type byte addr[0] as 8 bits into the bit stream (buffer +0x8, capacity bytes +0x1c, bit cursor +0x20, debug tag flag +0x29). Type 0 writes a 64-bit value from a local; type 2 writes the C string at addr+0x20 plus an 8-bit zero terminator; type 1 builds a sockaddr_in from IPv4 bytes addr+4..7 and port addr+8 (htons, snprintf, inet_pton) and writes it with 0x143aee4f0, returning success. Context from caller: used when reporting connections to clients.
